**What are you trying to do?**

Describe the harness work, not the feature — knowing the underlying job often
changes what the right feature is.

**What do you do today instead?**

**What would good look like?**

**Have you checked the roadmap?**

`docs/ROADMAP.md` and `docs/tasks/` cover a fair amount of planned work. If
this is already there, saying so is useful — it is a vote, and votes change
ordering.

**Scope check**

OpenHarness is deliberately local-only: no accounts, seats, billing, cloud
sharing, or live multi-user sync. If your request needs one of those, it is
probably out of scope — but say so anyway, because the underlying need may be
solvable another way.
